construction: The Q1481 Frobenius union of all cyclic length-27 normal-basis windows on the exact N131 curve. Enumerate the unique long-zero-gap representative of every nonzero raw x orbit, test rationality exactly, cofactor-project by [4], remove identity and duplicate projected signed-Frobenius orbits.
archive_encoding: Two-bit status for each raw orbit in Q1481 representatives(27) order: 0 nonrational, 1 rational with identity [4] image, 2 rational with nonidentity [4] image. The bitmap plus the frozen deterministic projection source and exact curve record specifies the full projected point set. Hash sorted unique canonical projected x keys as 17-byte little-endian integers.
claim_scope: Exact N131 factor-base geometry and a reconstructible compressed point-set archive only. This does not measure a decomposition, ordinary relation yield, rank, target descent, or complete solve work.
success_gates: Freeze source, dependencies, exact N131 curve record, checked Sage runtime, archive encoding and limits before exhaustive enumeration.
Process exactly 2^26 unique raw x-orbit representatives and preserve every two-bit status in the ordered archive.

Report exact rational, identity and duplicate counts by span, actual usable B, folded K and the sorted projected-set digest. Independently check group-law projection and bitmap membership on deterministic samples from every span.
Keep candidate_id and complete N131 2^x null until a full IC pipeline and all stage costs are measured.
